title: The item-write guard refuses a page item with no id
why: Owner comment 13:44 CST Nov 6 on item 289: "how do you still incorrectly build artifacts with this long known bug". Triage wrote 11 items by set with no id in their data; 5 older items had none either. The page shows a missing-id notice on each. Owner 13:44 CST in chat: "u make this mistake all the time how have we not mechanically fixed this".
note: Today only the page detects it: page.html shows a warning on the card (tests page.test.mjs 'an item stored with no id field ...'). Nothing refuses the write, so every writer repeats it. Fixed in data 13:46 CST (16 items given their id). Fix the cause: the guard that checks page item writes (rule page-item-design's hook) refuses a set or update that leaves items/<doc> with no data.id equal to the doc id. Red first on a set with no id. Option to weigh in the brief: the page and readers treat the doc key as the id, so no id field is needed at all.
